name: MTVQA
intro: MTVQA 是面向多语言文本中心场景的视觉问答基准。最终语料覆盖 9 种语言、8,794 张图像和 28,607 个问答对；其中测试集含 2,116 张图像和 6,778 个问答对。它以母语专家的制定者—审核者流程构建，并揭示多模态模型与人类在 OCR、跨语言理解和文本推理上的差距。
org: ByteDance Inc., Huazhong University of Science and Technology
build_method: 三源图像收集与母语专家制定者—审核者标注
metric: 目标答案子串准确率（先按文件均值，再做文件宏平均）
openness: 数据公开（CC BY-NC 4.0）；代码仓库未声明许可证
eval_feature: 九语言文本视觉问答, 子串匹配, 按语言宏平均
openness_en: Public data (CC BY-NC 4.0); code repository has no license file
build_method_en: Three-source image collection and native-speaker maker-checker annotation
eval_feature_en: Nine-language text VQA, substring matching, macro over language files
intro_en: MTVQA evaluates multilingual text-centric visual question answering. Its final corpus covers nine languages, 8,794 images, and 28,607 QA pairs; the test split contains 2,116 images and 6,778 QA pairs. Native-speaker maker-checker annotation exposes multimodal-model gaps in OCR, cross-lingual understanding, and text reasoning.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source review passed on 2026-07-21. The paper is pinned to arXiv:2405.11985v5 (last revised 2025-06-11; https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.11985v5; PDF SHA-256 f37ab7e63539235609fb655101b71443750a11fca48896a7988a402af13f8279). Official code is pinned to https://github.com/bytedance/MTVQA/tree/efc6a78a701516a76649430e1100c98e2904a7d8; the released scripts/acc.py evaluator is traced to commit 9659063458f3f9bbba8e70877277469b90171194 and has SHA-256 28a17554b1f9399fd616712fbe7e092d434cab23681561d7f0a67187c1dac713. Official data is pinned to https://huggingface.co/datasets/ByteDance/MTVQA/tree/7cdca63ec6cd71cdd0b52f79fc3176bb9ce36a9c. Paper Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.3 support the 30% public / 20% web / 50% manual source mix; multilingual OCR, language/text-amount and regulatory filtering from 8,980 raw images to 8,895 candidates; native speakers with at least ten years of active use and university education; training, Q&A and pilot; three first-round makers per language writing five QAs per image (three reading plus two reasoning); two independent checkers; 10% per-language audit with re-annotation; the 28,906-QA initial pool; final 8,794-image / 28,607-QA corpus; exact train 6,678 images / 21,829 QAs and test 2,116 / 6,778 splits; and the v5 ten-native-speaker-per-language human baseline of 79.7%. The pinned Hugging Face schema is image, id, qa_pairs and lang; qa_pairs is a Python-literal-style string, the release uses KR where the paper names KO, and no official dataset-to-evaluator adapter is released. The paper prompt asks for a word or phrase in the question language and uses model-default generation settings. The executable evaluator lowercases and strips both sides, removes periods only from the prediction, and awards 1 when any target is a substring rather than requiring exact equality. It averages rows within each JSON file and then takes an unweighted mean over files, does not enforce all nine language files, emits NumPy NaN for an empty directory, and aborts on missing directories, malformed JSON, missing keys, or empty target lists. The data snapshot declares CC BY-NC 4.0; the official code repository has no root LICENSE file. EN/ZH specs have identical node IDs, types, positions, and edges. Formal publication evidence [site-a11q-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4101×1161 (English) and 4101×1161 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4099×1159 and 4099×1159. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
